title: EmDash setup borrows and releases the verified host connection to an isolated site
steps: Run the real post-up function with isolated-site, bridged-host and fleet-loopback fixtures.
Interrupt connect, fail each network/helper boundary, vary host identity and supply an existing connection.
expect: The site remains on its private network and helpers use its inspected IP, even when a loopback listener appears later.
Only a running tracy-host on the correct stack borrows a connection; its connection is released on success, helper failure, INT and TERM.
Preexisting connections survive; failed cleanup cannot report success; fleet loopback does not join a network.
evidence: Local EmDash build 78122c67 failed because the isolated site was absent from the old shared network. The original orchestration failed the new regression before the fix. A real local hook subsequently completed mail, all 80 forms and Content API registration and released the host endpoint.
fence: The post-up subshell owns a temporary host endpoint under provision's per-label flock; the site's network and protected-token origin checks stay intact.

tests: isolated bridge: setup, mail and forms borrow only this host connection and release it
isolated bridge: interrupting connect releases the lease without running a helper
isolated bridge: a later loopback listener cannot replace the selected private origin
